title: nginx stub_status page disclosed
description: The response is the nginx stub_status template: the Active connections line followed by the accepts/handled/requests table is the fixed output of that module. It reports live connection counters.
remediation: Restrict the stub_status location to loopback or an internal monitoring network with an allow directive, or remove it.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the stub_status template; it cannot identify the proxied services or their configuration.
